H2: How to Use Original Protein Therapy – Step by Step

Here’s a simple guide to get the best results:

Step 1: Start by washing your hair with a clarifying shampoo to open up the pores. Leave it on for 3 minutes so the protein can reach every strand.

Step 2: Rinse thoroughly with plain water to remove all shampoo residue.

Step 3: Blow-dry your hair until it’s mostly dry, but keep it slightly damp.

Step 4: Prepare the right amount of protein from your special package, based on your hair length and thickness.

Step 5: Divide your hair into four sections. Use a comb to take thin strands from each section for treatment.

Step 6: Don’t forget your gloves! They protect your hands while applying the protein.

Step 7: Apply the protein strand by strand using a brush. Comb each strand with a narrow comb before moving to the next. Make sure to leave a 1 cm gap from your scalp to avoid irritation, especially if your scalp is sensitive.

Step 8: Once all strands are treated, comb through your hair again with a narrow comb for even distribution.

Step 9: Leave the treatment on for 60 minutes, then rinse thoroughly with water only — no shampoo needed.

Step 10: Straighten your hair using a flat iron set at 480°F (250°C). Comb through each strand and pass the iron 10–15 times to achieve smooth, silky, long-lasting results.
